messages.text: Pioneer Pete sparks jubilant Greatwood scenes at Cheltenham

metadata.summary: Pioneer Pete could have the County Hurdle back at Cheltenham in March as a target after continuing his charge up the two-mile hurdling rankings in the Unibet Greatwood Handicap Hurdle.
metadata.content: Cheltenham: Pioneer Pete sparks jubilant Greatwood scenes at November meeting | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Cheltenham: Pioneer Pete sparks jubilant Greatwood scenes at November meeting Pioneer Pete continued his ascent up the two-mile hurdling rankings when taking top honours in the Unibet Greatwood Handicap Hurdle under Jonjo O'Neill Jr; Tennessee Tango was second, with Morning Mayhem third. Sunday 15 November 2026 16:52, UK Image: Jonjo O'Neill Jr celebrates aboard Pioneer Pete Pioneer Pete could have the County Hurdle back at Cheltenham in March as a target after continuing his charge up the two-mile hurdling rankings in the Unibet Greatwood Handicap Hurdle. Posting a fourth win on the spin and backing up his impressive Welsh Champion Hurdle win at Chepstow, the likeable five-year-old was always in the front rank under Jonjo O'Neill Jnr and came clear to win by six and a half lengths at 7-2 from Tennessee Tango. Victory for O'Neill, winning on the horse for the fifth time and riding for his father-brother training combination of Jonjo and AJ O'Neill, put welcome gloss on a day in which he had fallen twice from three previous rides. "I thought Chepstow was his limit, but he is an amazing little horse," said O'Neill senior. "I have no idea how much more is left in the locker, but he is a horse in form and you would have to look at all those options like the County Hurdle now." metadata.summary: Johnny Fisher is looking to return to action early in 2027 and wants to fight Kristian Prenga, the man who almost derailed the Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua mega-fight.
metadata.content: Johnny Fisher wants to fight Kristian Prenga, the man who almost derailed Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua, early next year | Boxing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Exclusive Johnny Fisher wants to fight Kristian Prenga, the man who almost derailed Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua, early next year Kristian Prenga almost knocked out Anthony Joshua in his tune up fight before Tyson Fury; Johnny Fisher now wants to test himself against Prenga early in 2027; Watch Aaron McKenna vs Jevgenijs Aleksejevs on Friday December 4 live on Sky Sports John Dennen Sports Journalist @johndennen Sunday 15 November 2026 17:41, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Watch the moment Anthony Joshua sealed victory over Kristian Prenga with a huge second-round knockout. Courtesy of DAZN Johnny Fisher is looking to return to action early in 2027 and wants to fight Kristian Prenga, the man who almost derailed the Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua mega-fight. In July, Prenga boxed Joshua in what was meant to be a tune-up fight for the former world champion. Instead Prenga put him down heavily twice in their first round. He was on the edge of victory only for Joshua to storm back and knock him out in the second round. Prenga caught the eye of the boxing world in that fight and Fisher would like the man who almost beat Joshua to be his next opponent. metadata.summary: Former Australia bowler Chadd Sayers has challenged Pat Cummins' account of the sandpaper scandal, restating his belief that "everyone in that side" was aware of the ball tampering plot.

Pictures courtesy of Sports Entertainment Network Former Australia bowler Chadd Sayers has challenged Pat Cummins' account of the sandpaper scandal, restating his belief that "everyone in that side" was aware of the ball tampering plot. Sayers, who was 12th man in the ill-fated Newlands Test and won his only cap in the subsequent match, has lined up alongside Khawaja, having previously claimed "everything Usman said was accurate". Speaking to SEN Radio ahead of the second ODI against England in Adelaide, the 39-year-old said: "I'm comfortable sitting here right now and where I stand on the situation, that I believe everyone in that side knew what was going on and what was being used. messages.text: Lions thump Patriots in Munich on St Brown's German homecoming

metadata.summary: Jahmyr Gibbs was unstoppable and Amon-Ra St Brown starred on his German homecoming as the Detroit Lions torched the Drake Maye-less New England Patriots 35-10 at the Allianz Arena in Munich on Sunday.
metadata.content: NFL: Detorit Lions thump New England Patriots in Germany after Drake Maye injury as Amon-Ra St Brown and Jahmyr Gibbs star | NFL News | Sky Sports Skip to main content NFL: Detorit Lions thump New England Patriots in Germany after Drake Maye injury as Amon-Ra St Brown and Jahmyr Gibbs star Jahmyr Gibbs posts 252 scrimmage yards and two touchdowns while the New England Patriots lose quarterback Drake Maye to injury on the opening drive of the game; the Detroit Lions emerge 35-10 winners at the Allianz Arena in Munich in the NFL's eighth of nine international games in 2026 Cam Hogwood NFL Journalist @ch_skysports Sunday 15 November 2026 19:18, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Amon-Ra St Brown scores his second touchdown of the game to extend the Detroit Lions' lead over the New England Patriots Jahmyr Gibbs was unstoppable and Amon-Ra St Brown starred on his German homecoming as the Detroit Lions torched the Drake Maye-less New England Patriots 35-10 at the Allianz Arena in Munich on Sunday. Gibbs finished with 252 yards and two touchdowns from scrimmage, including 153 rushing yards and 99 through the air, while St Brown - born to a German mother - recorded four catches for 98 yards and two scores to reward his hero's welcome in Europe. New England's offense capitulated after the opening drive of the game when Drake Maye suffered an ankle injury before being replaced by Tommy DeVito at quarterback.
